title: Separable residue extensions along a tame trait section
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, $\sigma:S\to C$ a section, and $G$ a finite group with order invertible in $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$ exhibit the generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product], with a section $s_\eta$ satisfying $q s_\eta=1$ and $j s_\eta=\sigma a_\eta$. Let $Z\to C_\eta$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor. Let $U\subset S$ contain $\eta$, let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale, and let $j_U:C_\eta\to C_U$ and $\psi:Z\to P$ exhibit its generic restriction, with $i_Uj_U=j$. Let $s\notin U$ be such that every $t\notin U$ specializing to $s$ equals $s$. Put $a:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $l:L\to C$, and let $N\to C$ be the concrete relative normalization of $P\to C_U\to C$. Let $\tau=(a\sigma,1):\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to L$ be the induced section. Assume $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ is a discrete valuation ring and that $n:N\times_C L\to L$ is finite. For each point $x$ of $N\times_C L$ with $n(x)=\tau(\mathfrak m_{S,s})$, the residue extension $\kappa(x)/\kappa(n(x))$ induced by the canonical local stalk map of $n$ is separable. No rational point of the generic section fibre is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the existing trait normalization chart theorem. At n(x), choose one of its covering affine etale maps. On its pullback, transport residue separability of the finite product of tame root algebras through the supplied isomorphism over the affine base. The root-product calculation handles both zero and nonzero divisor values, so no section or divisor-equation compatibility needs to be reconstructed.

Lift x and the selected affine-base point to a point of the pullback using Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback. The base chart has separable residue extensions because it is etale. Compose this extension with the separable chart extension. Pullback commutativity identifies the composite with the map through n. The original source residue field embeds into the pullback residue field, so Algebra.IsSeparable.of_algHom descends separability to it. These operations are proved in private Lean helpers using residueFieldMap_comp, Algebra.IsSeparable.trans, and the etale residue-field instance. Finally identify the residue-map algebra with the canonical stalk-map quotient algebra.

theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_trait_section_residue_separable {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    let τ : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ pullback c a :=
      pullback.lift (a ≫ σ) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ])
    IsFinite n → ∀ x : (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
      (pullback.fst c a) : Scheme.{u}),
      n x = τ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (S.presheaf.stalk s)) →
      letI := (n.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
      letI : IsLocalHom
          (algebraMap ((pullback c a).presheaf.stalk (n x))
            ((pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
              (pullback.fst c a)).presheaf.stalk x)) :=
        inferInstanceAs <| IsLocalHom (n.stalkMap x).hom
      Algebra.IsSeparable
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ((pullback c a).presheaf.stalk (n x)))
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
          ((pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
            (pullback.fst c a)).presheaf.stalk x))
